# Local fixture pages

Small pages for tests. They have no scripts and load nothing from the
internet.

| File | What it checks |
|---|---|
| normal-page.html | Basic size and density |
| long-page.html | Full page, 12000 CSS px tall |
| lazy-images.html | Lazy images and "Scroll for lazy images" |
| fixed-elements.html | Fixed and sticky elements in full page |
| viewport-units.html | Heights in vh that follow the viewport (aspect ratio) |
